name: Onitsha

sources.evidence: Current ministry page says ANAMGIS is a state geospatial data repository for land administration; no anonymous map/API linked.
Official Smart Anambra page explicitly says informational page, not online application.
Official online services page advertises Land Register Printout including owner(s) and historical register; no parcel geometry queried.
Official ministry notice names Onitsha layouts, describes review/update of land records and plot-holder information; application form is from ANAMGIS Service Center, Ministry of Lands, Awka.
World Bank Doing Business procedure for Onitsha says title searches occur in Awka and that there was no Land Registry in Onitsha at report date; historical, not proof of current office status.

blocker: No anonymous Onitsha parcel polygons. Official services expose land records, but the linked printout concerns owner/history data and was not queried.
registryBasis: Onitsha-specific land records administered through Anambra State Ministry of Lands; official notice identifies Onitsha layouts and says ANAMGIS service center/application is in Awka. A 2014 World Bank procedure report explicitly says title searches were conducted in Awka because there was no Land Registry in Onitsha. This supports city-scoped records, not a local Onitsha registry office.
